items.title: Sweet Williams Interview
items.q: He had a brother called Yellow. Red and Yellow. They both played.

ctx.x: Yellow what? I don't know. I don't know. Yellow Butch? Could that be?

I believe so. Yellow. He had a brother called Yellow. Red and Yellow. They both played. Little Willie. Little Willie. Little Willie. Little Willie. What? Little Willie. That's all I know. Little Willie. He played here like Hell. Used to have jam sessions between him and the great guy. They was the best down there playing lead piano by himself. That's in my days. That's in my days.
What did he play? Lead piano? Played piano. Just solo piano.
